text: 金十数据9月9日讯，A股三大指数今日涨跌不一，沪指走势较强，科创50指数高开低走。截至收盘，上证指数涨0.28%，深证成指涨0.15%，创业板指跌0.14%，北证50跌0.41%，科创50指数跌0.69%。沪深两市成交额1.86万亿，较上一个交易日缩量1047亿。盘面上，市场热点集中于前期热门板块，两市场超3500只个股下跌。贵金属板块午后拉升，莱绅通灵涨停，湖南黄金触及涨停，中金黄金、晓程科技等跟涨。军工板块表现活跃，湖南天雁涨停。此外，文化传媒板块全天低迷，三人行、出版传媒跌停，芒果超媒、流金科技、读者传媒均大跌。房地产板块震荡调整，我爱我家、信达地
text_en: Jin10 Data September 9: A-share three major indices ended mixed today; the Shanghai Composite was relatively strong, while the STAR 50 opened higher and fell. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.15%, ChiNext fell 0.14%, Beijing Stock Exchange 50 fell 0.41%, and STAR 50 fell 0.69%. Total turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets reached 1.86 trillion yuan, down 104.7 billion from the previous session. On the board, market hotspots focused on previously hot sectors, with over 3,500 stocks falling across both markets. Precious metals rallied in the afternoon, with Lyshen Tongling hitting the daily limit, Hunan Gold touching the limit, and Zhongjin Gold, Xiaocheng Technology among gainers. Defense sector was active, with Hunan Tianyan hitting the limit up. Additionally, the cultural media sector was weak all day, with Sanrenxing and Publishing Media hitting limit down, while Mango Excellent Media, Liujin Technology, and Duzhe Media all fell sharply.
